steps.sql: SET NOCOUNT OFF; SELECT 1 AS id,CAST(LEFT(N'🦆',1) AS NVARCHAR(4)) AS s,CAST(LEFT(N'🦆',1) AS NCHAR(4)) AS f INTO typed_stage
SELECT UNICODE(LEFT(N'🦆',1)) AS h,UNICODE(RIGHT(N'🦆',1)) AS l,UNICODE(N'') AS e,UNICODE(NULL) AS n,UNICODE(12) AS d
SELECT id,s,f,LEN(s) AS units,DATALENGTH(s) AS bytes FROM typed_stage ORDER BY id
SET NOCOUNT OFF; SELECT 1 AS id,CAST(LEFT(N'🦆',1) AS NVARCHAR(4)) AS s,CAST(LEFT(N'🦆',1) AS NCHAR(4)) AS f INTO typed_stage
SELECT UNICODE(s) AS h,UNICODE(f) AS f FROM typed_stage
SELECT id,s,f,LEN(s) AS units,DATALENGTH(s) AS bytes FROM typed_stage ORDER BY id
SET NOCOUNT OFF; SELECT 1 AS id,CAST(LEFT(N'🦆',1) AS NVARCHAR(4)) AS s,CAST(LEFT(N'🦆',1) AS NCHAR(4)) AS f INTO typed_stage
UPDATE typed_stage SET s=RIGHT(N'🦆',1) OUTPUT UNICODE(deleted.s) AS old_unit,UNICODE(inserted.s) AS new_unit
SELECT id,s,f,LEN(s) AS units,DATALENGTH(s) AS bytes FROM typed_stage ORDER BY id
SET NOCOUNT OFF; SELECT 1 AS id,CAST(LEFT(N'🦆',1) AS NVARCHAR(4)) AS s,CAST(LEFT(N'🦆',1) AS NCHAR(4)) AS f INTO typed_stage
SELECT UNICODE(s) AS h FROM typed_stage WHERE 1=0
SELECT id,s,f,LEN(s) AS units,DATALENGTH(s) AS bytes FROM typed_stage ORDER BY id
